vulnerability.name: USN-5658-3
vulnerability.description: USN-5658-1 fixed several vulnerabilities in DHCP. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 14.04 ESM.  Original advisory details:   It was discovered that DHCP incorrectly handled option reference counting.  A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause DHCP servers to  crash, resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2022-2928)   It was discovered that DHCP incorrectly handled certain memory operations.  A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause DHCP clients and  servers to consume resources, leading to a denial of service.  (CVE-2022-2929)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in DHCP. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
